fusions.name: Shed Tine
fusions.desc: Breaks a branching tine from your own antlers, costing 4% of your maximum health, and hurls it at one enemy within 7 tiles for 9 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Startled Thicket
fusions.desc: Brambles burst from the ground around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 2.5 tiles. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Browse Line
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 30% for 9 seconds and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Game Trail
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%, and you gain 10% plant resistance.
